title: Lifted constant-realization scalar comparison
statement: For a scheme X, commutative rings B and C, a ring map q : B → C, and a cochain complex P of B-modules, derived constant realization of the coefficient-universe lift of P followed by derived scalar extension along the lifted map is isomorphic to the finite constant model over C of ordinary scalar extension of P along q. The constant functors preserve zero morphisms.

proof.text: Use the constant-realization derived scalar comparison for the lifted ring map.
Transport the lifted scalar-extension functor across the universe-lift equivalence and identify the resulting complex with the finite constant model over C.

theorem finiteModel_constantScalarExtension_liftComparison
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {B C : Type t} [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    (q : B →+* C)
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X C).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      ((ConstantScalarRealization.derivedExtension (ProEt.topology X)
          (RingHom.ulift.{t + 1, t + 1} q)).obj
          ((commutativeSiteDerivedConstantModuleFunctor (ProEt.topology X)
            (ULift.{t + 1} B)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              (((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                  (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
                    (.up ℤ)).obj P))) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (finiteModelConstantComplex X C
            (((ModuleCat.extendScalars q).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
